messages:
tasha: opened PR to add a short how-to for remapping dashboard metric names and a tiny tracing-hook sanity check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5422

ryan: quick scan: love the jq one-liner. small request: make the PromQL example use `increase(...)` for rollups and show a per-request division example.

mina: noted. adding PromQL: `sum(increase(console_unit_cost_total[1h])) by (service)` and per-request: `sum(increase(console_unit_cost_total[1h])) by (service) / sum(increase(request_count_total[1h])) by (service)`.

ryan: tracing tip: some runtimes add `0x` prefix. Suggest showing resilient normalization in snippets. Ex: Python `trace_id = trace.id.hex(); if trace_id.startswith('0x'): trace_id = trace_id[2:]` and Node `const traceId = (trace.id || '').replace(/^0x/, '')`. Add a one-line explanation about sampling affecting attribution.

mina: added both and a short note: "If traces are sampled out, trace-linked panels will underreport attributed cost; prefer metric rollups for billing checks."

assets-bot: Uploaded 2 images to /assets/images/docs/observability/remap-before.png and remap-after.png

doc-bot: CI: linkcheck found 0 broken links. Lint: code fence language suggestion for promql block.

tasha: fixed fence language and pushed. Also added backup suggestion: copy exported dashboards dir before running jq/sed.

ryan: LGTM. who merges?

tasha: I'll merge once staging preview passes. Thanks! :shipit:
